en:
Motors and Motor Controllers

Motion methods allow the V5 Brain to control different types of motors and motion devices by adjusting their speed, direction, and rotation.

Each device type rotates according to its configuration in the Devices window.

Below is a list of available devices:

  • Motor and Motor Group - Controls a single V5 Smart Motor with built-in encoder feedback, precise motion control, and advanced movement features, or multiple V5 Smart Motors operating together as a synchronized unit with shared motion commands and settings.
  • Motor Controller 55 - Controls DC motors using variable voltage.
  • Motor 393 (Motor Controller 29) - A 2-wire DC motor controlled via a VEX 3-Wire Motor Controller 29.
  • Victor 883 - A legacy motor controller that takes a 3-Wire PWM signal from the Brain to control VEXpro/EDR DC motors that can't plug directly into Smart Ports.
  • Servo Motor - A position-controlled 3-wire motor that rotates within a fixed range.
zh:
电机与电机控制器

运动方式允许V5主控器通过调节速度、方向和旋转来控制不同类型的电机和运动装置。

每种设备类型根据其在“设备”窗口中的配置进行轮换。

以下是可用设备的列表：

  • 电机和电机组- 控制具有内置编码器反馈、精确运动控制和高级运动功能的单个 V5 智能电机，或作为具有共享运动命令和设置的同步单元一起运行的多个 V5 智能电机。
  • 电机照明 55- 使用可变电压控制直流电机。
  • 电机 393（电机照明 29）- 通过 VEX 3 线电机照明 29 控制的 2 线直流电机。
  • Victor 883- 传统电机照明，采用主控器的 3 线 PWM 信号来控制无法直接插入智能端口的 VEXpro/EDR 直流电机。
  • 伺服电机- 在固定范围内旋转的位置控制 3 线电机。
